jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Intelligence Analyst is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across intelligence analyst specialist operations workflows. Reviewers grade workflow correctness, policy adherence, and stakeholder fit; flag operational risk; and document the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Intelligence Analyst specialist operations AI has to fit into an actual day at work. AuraOne uses experienced operators to grade outputs the way a senior peer would — checking workflow, policy, and the unwritten rules that decide whether a task actually gets done.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current intelligence analyst specialist operations workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for Intelligence Analyst assignments.
* Grade tone, escalation logic, and stakeholder fit on a structured rubric.
* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience in intelligence analyst specialist operations on real teams for Intelligence Analyst work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Grade a model's response to a real intelligence analyst specialist operations ticket and rate workflow, tone, and escalation.
* Flag a missed escalation with the right severity tag and corrected next step.
* Adjudicate a disputed playbook call between two reviewers using firm guidance.
* Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Prior experience training, calibrating, or QA-ing operations teams.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflow tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross-region operations.

**Skills**
----------

* Operational review
* Policy adherence
* Workflow judgment
* Stakeholder communication
* Intelligence Analyst specialist operations

**Work model**
--------------

Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

**Compensation**
----------------

Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

##### **Your Impact**

Own your opportunity to support our nation's defense. Make an impact by connecting and securing critical operations across the globe, keeping our country safe and secure.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Transform technology into opportunity as a **Senior Business Analyst** at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

  
  

The Naval Enterprise Service Desk (NESD) program is deploying a cognitive Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform integrated with a COTS IT Service Management (ITSM) solution to consolidate Tier 1 IT service desks and automate incident resolution. As the Navy’s solution partner, GDIT is implementing leading-edge technology to support the Navy’s evolving business model.

  
  

In this role, you will work collaboratively with an agile team of product owners, system users, and developers to capture, document, and refine requirements that populate the Agile sprint backlog. The ideal candidate brings leadership, data analysis, and requirements analysis skills to ensure designed solutions align with business and mission objectives. Experience with service desks, ITSM, and AI is preferred; however, if you have strong business/technical analysis experience and a genuine interest in learning about new technologies, we’d like to speak with you. Because this is a client-facing role, strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential.

  
  

**MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT**
  
As a **Senior Business Analyst** the work you’ll lead the translation of Government stakeholders’ business needs into technical requirements that drive NESD Service Desk capabilities across the Cognitive AI platform, Contact Center, and ITSM suite.

* Lead the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business processes and functional requirements for NESD solutions.
* Perform system function analysis to ensure capabilities align with stakeholder needs and Navy ITSM objectives.
* Facilitate and collaborate with Government and Program stakeholders, system users, and development teams on design recommendations and documentation.
* Coordinate across business and technology teams to ensure requirements are understood, traceable, testable, and prioritized within the product backlog.
* Work with developers and engineers to translate functional requirements into technical specifications, user stories, and, where applicable, scripts or configuration details.
* Partner with Cognitive AI, Contact Center, and ITSM developers to design integrated end-to-end solutions.
* Maintain and organize requirements, user stories, and supporting artifacts in an agile work management platform (e.g., Jira).
* Participate in and support agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews/close-out, and backlog refinement).
* Review solution designs to verify alignment with requirements, stakeholder expectations, and program constraints.
* Engage directly with Customer and Program stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and validate proposed solutions.
* Support testing activities (e.g., requirements validation, UAT support), ensuring defects are traced back to requirements and that acceptance criteria are met.
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED**

Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. Our **Senior Business Analyst** must have:

* **Security Clearance:** Active Secret clearance.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of experience translating business requirements into technical requirements for software engineering or similar technical teams, including work on complex or multi-system initiatives.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Practical familiarity with AI/cognitive or machine learning concepts, or a strong interest and demonstrated ability to learn these quickly.
* **Tools:** Experience with agile work management platforms (e.g., Jira, or similar).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field (ideally Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related). Additional years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* **Work Location:** Remote.
* **Citizenship:** US Citizenship required.
  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience working on IT service desk or ITSM implementations (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Remedy/Helix, or similar platforms).
* Experience with cognitive AI, virtual agents, or chatbots integrated into contact center or ITSM solutions.
* Background supporting DoW or Federal programs, particularly the U.S. Navy or other service branches.
* Hands-on experience working within Scrum or other Agile frameworks, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Familiarity with data analytics, reporting, or metrics related to service desk performance and customer experience (e.g., FCR, AHT, CSAT).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL Foundation, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or similar).

**Job Description**
-------------------

INFORMATION SECURITY ANALYST SR PRINCIPAL
  
  
Advance your career while impacting our national security in cyber as an Information Security Analyst Sr Principal at GDIT. Here, technologists have many paths to grow a meaningful career supporting cyber missions and operations across the federal government.
  
  
MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As an Information Security Analyst Sr Principal, the work you do at GDIT will directly support the mission of our federal customer. You will play a critical role in achieving and sustaining the Authorization to Operate (ATO) for enterprise systems within a federal government agency. This position places you at the intersection of cloud technologies and Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC), contributing to an innovative and high‑visibility program.

We are seeking a candidate willing to join our Assessment & Authorization (A&A) team across all phases of the NIST Risk Management Framework, including:

  
  

* Categorizing information and system components
* Conducting Privacy Impact Assessments
* Developing risk management strategies
* Creating and maintaining security documentation
* Developing Security Control Implementation Statements
* Developing, tracking, and following up on Plans of Action and Milestones (POAM)
* Gathering information essential for drafting security controls, policies, and process documentation

  
  

You will develop Security Impact Analyses (SIA) for system changes and update key security documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Information Security Contingency Plan, and other required security artifacts. You will coordinate with Federal Government officials to obtain and maintain the system’s Authorization to Operate (ATO).

  
  

You will ensure compliance with federal regulations and privacy requirements. Responsibilities include conducting investigations of information system security violations and incidents, security vulnerabilities, and reporting findings to management as necessary. You will also perform periodic and ad‑hoc system audits and vulnerability assessments including reviews of system scans, audit log reviews, user accounts, application access, file system integrity, and compliance‑related configurations.

  
  

Additionally, you will need to have experience with governance risk and compliance (GRC) tools such as JCAM/Archangel/Xacta. You will also participate in the Change Management process, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, customers and stakeholders on various projects as needed to ensure IT systems remain compliant with security requirements.

* Education: Technical Training, Certification(s) or Degree
* Experience: 8+ years of related experience
* Technical skills: Information System Security, IT Risk Management, Cyber Security, Compliance, Change Management, Security Control Statements, Security Documentation, JCAM/Archangel/Xacta
* Security clearance level: Active Secret, Top Secret Preferred
* US citizenship required
* Role requirements: Onsite, travel 10%

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**About BeInCrypto**
--------------------

BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone. Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking a hands-on Research Analyst to develop and deliver high-quality institutional research at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets. You will take ownership of the research process, from identifying relevant topics and analysing data to producing insightful, accurate, and publication-ready reports.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Own the end-to-end research process, from identifying relevant topics and developing research angles to data analysis, report writing, and final quality control.
* Produce clear, insightful, institutional-grade research reports covering traditional finance, digital assets, market trends, and emerging opportunities.
* Critically evaluate data, challenge assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and ensure the accuracy and credibility of research findings, including AI-generated content.
* Identify relevant industry trends, research opportunities, and insights that resonate with institutional audiences.
* Collaborate with editorial, product, design, and commercial teams to develop valuable research products, including reports, indices, and premium research offerings.
* Engage with industry experts and data providers when needed to gather insights, validate findings, and strengthen research quality.

**You are the perfect match if you:**
-------------------------------------

* Have proven hands-on experience in traditional finance research, financial journalism, or market intelligence, ideally with exposure to digital assets.
* Have experience working at an established financial research firm, financial institution, market intelligence provider, or leading financial media outlet.
* Can independently manage research projects from initial analysis to a complete, publication-ready report.
* Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, challenge conclusions, and develop original insights.
* Can produce well-structured, accurate, and engaging research reports in fluent English.
* Are confident working with financial data, research platforms, and AI tools while independently validating and improving their outputs.
* Understand institutional financial markets and can identify research topics relevant to professional audiences.
* Have a product mindset and understand how high-quality research can create value for audiences and support commercial opportunities.

**What we offer to you:**
-------------------------

* 100% remote work with no location restrictions.
* Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone.
* Paid time off to recharge.
* Direct collaboration with the CEO and executive leadership on research strategy and institutional initiatives.
* Access to leading data platforms and research tools, among which are Glassnode, CryptoQuant, Messari, DelphiDigital, LunarCrush, Nansen, Santiment, Dune, and others.
* Opportunities to build your personal brand through speaking engagements, podcasts, conferences, and media appearances.
* Access to major crypto and fintech events around the world.
* Internal learning programs, masterclasses, and knowledge sharing.
* Clear goals, measurable outcomes, and a data-driven culture where your work has a visible business impact.
* An inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs, can thrive.

**Meet our team:**
------------------

You’ll be working with the Multimedia Global Newsroom team. Your manager will be Chief Global Strategy Officer. This team is the heart of BeInCrypto - reporting and original research on digital assets and institutional finance, published in 26 languages.

**Ready to start your new journey with us?**
--------------------------------------------

At BIC, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together!  
  
Recruitment process: Portfolio review HR interview Take-home assignment Interview with our Managing Editor and Chief Global Strategy Officer Offer.  
  
Apply now, and our Recruitment team will contact you with the next steps.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Meet our Professional Services Team!**

Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We’re looking for experienced CCaaS project managers to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you’ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.

**What You'll Do**

Sprinklr is looking for a Project Manager with expertise in CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) operations to manage enterprise-level projects for Sprinklr’s largest customers. In this role, you will be both responsible for the end-to-end delivery of multi-market, global implementations across multiple customer verticals.

Responsibilities:

* Own and manage end-to-end project management of CCaaS implementation including stakeholder management, project scope, product enhancements, change control processes, and risk mitigation plans.
* The Project Manager ensures that customer business requirements and KPIs are being implemented according to defined scope, requirements and best practices and value is being delivered at every touch point.
* Partner with Sprinklr’s cross-functional enablement functions and leaders to ensure alignment and transparency at every project stage.
* Drive meaningful relationships with key customer and internal stakeholders, as well as executives, ensuring all parties are providing requisite participation and accountability.
* Maintain deep Sprinklr platform knowledge to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and workstreams.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed and communicated effectively.
* Lead a team striving for quality and excellence in all aspects of project delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn

reports to the relevant project stakeholders.  

* Maintain awareness of the CCaaS industry to provide subject matter expertise and guidance internally and for Sprinklr customers.

* Fluent in English and Arabic (Mandatory)

* Experience in global (multi-geo/multi-cultural) rollouts
* Strong Project Management experience coupled with certifications such as PMP, Prince2 Agile, ACP strongly preferred
* Strong stakeholder management experience including at the executive level
* Experience managing various deployment types (centralized, decentralized, huband-spoke)
* Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk models, perform resource allocations and run large-scale cross-functional team meetings
* Ability to lead and motivate large teams without direct supervision, leveraging mediation and stakeholder management skills
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycles
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Experience:

* Contact center operations
* Contact center network, ACD/IVR, dialer, workforce management, software or other solution operations or technical experience
* Technical configuration experience with CCaaS or similar SaaS solutions

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

  

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is a high-impact leadership role responsible for managing a portfolio of aerospace and defense development programs, new product introductions (NPI), and production transition efforts involving ruggedized electronic systems and mission-critical hardware. Reporting directly to the General Manager, the TPM serves as the primary customer interface and is accountable for program execution, financial performance, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of technical and contractual commitments.

This position requires a technically strong leader with experience managing complex defense and aerospace programs from proposal and development through qualification, production, and lifecycle support. The ideal candidate understands the challenges of developing high-reliability products in regulated environments and can effectively lead cross-functional teams to achieve cost, schedule, technical, and quality objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a portfolio of aerospace and defense development, qualification, NPI, and production programs.
* Serve as the primary interface with customers, ensuring strong relationships and proactive communication.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Contracts, and Finance.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, statements of work, technical specifications, and contractual deliverables.
* Manage Estimates at Completion (EACs), Estimates to Complete (ETCs), revenue forecasts, profitability projections, and cash flow performance.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, schedule, supply chain, quality, and financial risks while capturing opportunities to improve program performance.
* Lead proposal development, cost estimating, and bid activities for new business opportunities.
* Conduct customer reviews, executive status briefings, technical reviews, and internal program governance reviews.
* Drive successful transition of development programs into production while maintaining customer satisfaction and business objectives.

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other STEM discipline.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Meet our Professional Services Team!**

Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We’re looking for experienced CCaaS project managers to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you’ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.

**What You'll Do**

Sprinklr is looking for a Project Manager with expertise in CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) operations to manage enterprise-level projects for Sprinklr’s largest customers. In this role, you will be both responsible for the end-to-end delivery of multi-market, global implementations across multiple customer verticals.

Responsibilities:

* Own and manage end-to-end project management of CCaaS implementation including stakeholder management, project scope, product enhancements, change control processes, and risk mitigation plans.
* The Project Manager ensures that customer business requirements and KPIs are being implemented according to defined scope, requirements and best practices and value is being delivered at every touch point.
* Partner with Sprinklr’s cross-functional enablement functions and leaders to ensure alignment and transparency at every project stage.
* Drive meaningful relationships with key customer and internal stakeholders, as well as executives, ensuring all parties are providing requisite participation and accountability.
* Maintain deep Sprinklr platform knowledge to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and workstreams.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed and communicated effectively.
* Lead a team striving for quality and excellence in all aspects of project delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn

reports to the relevant project stakeholders.  

* Maintain awareness of the CCaaS industry to provide subject matter expertise and guidance internally and for Sprinklr customers.

Experience:

* Fluent in English and Arabic (Mandatory)
* 5 + years' Experience in CCaaS delivery/deployment, Contact Centers, or similar industry
* Experience in global (multi-geo/multi-cultural) rollouts
* Strong Project Management experience coupled with certifications such as PMP, Prince2 Agile, ACP strongly preferred
* Strong stakeholder management experience including at the executive level
* Experience managing various deployment types (centralized, decentralized, huband-spoke)
* Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk models, perform resource allocations and run large-scale cross-functional team meetings
* Ability to lead and motivate large teams without direct supervision, leveraging mediation and stakeholder management skills
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycles
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Experience:

* Contact center operations
* Contact center network, ACD/IVR, dialer, workforce management, software or other solution operations or technical experience
* Technical configuration experience with CCaaS or similar SaaS solutions

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing.
